name: Kopi Aren Latte EDP
packaging: Frosted bottle with a latte-gradient, café-cup inspired cap
target: Gen Z & young professionals in big cities
why: Kopi susu with gula aren is Jakarta's most sought-after drink, coffee perfumes are just starting in Korea, and gourmands are moving toward creamy, toasted textures. No local brand owns this yet.

name: Mood Mist Layering Kit
format: 3 body mists (Calm, Energy, Sleep) designed to layer with an EDP
packaging: Colour-coded mists in one box with a layering guide
target: Gen Z who already buy body mists
why: Functional, mood-led fragrance is being discussed locally, layering is rising, and fresh scents are the top preference. Body mists are an easy, low-price entry.

name: Discovery Wardrobe Set
packaging: Book-style box with a 'which scent when' card; works for gifting
why: Consumers are building fragrance wardrobes instead of one signature scent, and 50 ml and discovery sets are replacing 100 ml as the default.

name: Nusantara Sheer Series
format: Sheer EDP line, 3 scents, low projection
packaging: Minimal clear bottle with a textured local-paper label and origin card
why: Korean brands are winning with sheer scents built on heritage ingredients, and local stories (soliflore, Indonesian materials) are gaining value at home and abroad.

name: Real Tropical Fruit Line
packaging: Soft pastel bottles with soft-touch caps
target: Gen Z, daily wear in hot weather
why: Realistic fruit is leading niche launches for Gen Z, candy-like fruit is fading, and local fruits fit the Indonesian preference for fresh scents.

name: Clean Laundry Unisex
packaging: Clean white bottle, mood-based name, no gender label
why: Clean laundry with herbal facets is a niche-fair favourite, unisex woody-fresh scents are rising, and gendered labels are fading.

name: Alcohol-free Body Parfum
packaging: Aluminium bottle with an ingredient panel
why: Alcohol-free and water-based formulas are rising abroad, Middle Eastern fragrance culture is growing in Indonesia, and shoppers want to understand ingredients.
